title: MANTRA: Enhancing Automated Method-Level Refactoring with Contextual RAG and Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration

defines.name: MANTRA
defines.definition: An end-to-end LLM agent-based framework for automated method-level refactoring that aims to produce compilable, test-passing, and readable refactored code.

problem: Existing LLM-based refactoring approaches are limited in scope and lack reliable mechanisms to ensure compilability, test success, and developer-like refactoring quality.
